definitions.gloss: must-have; something one must carry; indispensable
definitions.explanation: Something that should always be carried or kept at hand, such as a handbook for a job or an item required at an event. Common in book titles, advertisements, and instructions to participants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨具|あまぐ}→雨具：15299_amagu⟧{必携|ひっけい}。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧{必携|ひっけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a must-have book for new nurses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{非常食|ひじょうしょく}→非常食：18765_hijoushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{必携|ひっけい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When climbing, you must carry a map and emergency food.

notes:
Mostly placed after a noun naming who needs the item: 〜{必携|ひっけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (a book every ~ must have).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{必携|ひっけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧: a must-have book for ~
- ⟦{筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}→筆記用具：15962_hikkiyougu⟧{必携|ひっけい}: bring writing materials (on a notice)
- {必携|ひっけい}⟦アイテム→アイテム：07813_aitemu⟧: must-have item (advertising)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧: indispensable, required in general; {必携|ひっけい} is specifically something to carry or keep at hand
- ⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: necessities, things one cannot do without
